Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Motisons Jewellers Limited reported strong financial performance for FY24, driven by increased revenue, expanding EBITDA margins, and net profit growth following successful IPO allotment and debt reduction. Management highlighted their strategic focus on inventory management, expanding SKUs, and leveraging both physical showrooms and online platforms for customer reach. The company plans to pursue future retail expansions pan-India and into different demographic areas while continuing to invest in technology and product innovation. Motisons Jewellers Limited reported a healthy financial performance for the financial year ended March 31, 2026, recording total income of Rs. 49,583.69 Lakhs and a net profit of Rs.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that revenue growth was boosted by increasing demand for the marriage season and festivals like Diwali and Akshaya Tritiya.
demand_outlook.quote: See the revenue part has been given a boost by the increasing demand for the marriage season and the festivals like Diwali and Akshaya Tritiya.

demand_outlook.claim: The Indian jewellery industry demonstrated resilience during FY 2025-26, supported by strong wedding and festive demand, increasing consumer preference for branded jewellery, and an ongoing shift from the unorganised to the organised retail segment.
demand_outlook.quote: The Indian jewellery industry continued to demonstrate resilience during FY 2025-26, supported by strong wedding and festive demand, increasing consumer preference for branded jewellery, and the ongoing shift from the unorganised to the organised retail segment.

demand_outlook.claim: Industry reports indicate that revenue growth in the organised jewellery sector remained robust, driven largely by higher gold prices and increasing demand for studded, lightweight, and design-oriented jewellery products.
demand_outlook.quote: Industry reports indicate that revenue growth in the organised jewellery sector remained robust, driven largely by higher gold prices and increasing demand for studded, lightweight, and design-oriented jewellery products.

demand_outlook.claim: The industry is expected to be supported by rising disposable incomes, favourable demographic trends, growing brand consciousness, and continued formalisation of the sector, although fluctuations in precious metal prices and global economic uncertainties may continue to influence consumer purchasing behaviour.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, the industry is expected to be supported by rising disposable incomes, favourable demographic trends, growing brand consciousness, and continued formalisation of the sector, although fluctuations in precious metal prices and global economic uncertainties may continue to influence consumer purchasing behaviour.

demand_outlook.claim: The company keeps on launching new jewellery designs and collections from time to time in view of changing trends and customer preferences.
demand_outlook.quote: In view of the changing trends, customers preferences and demands, the Company keeps on launching new jewellery designs and collections from time to time.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning for a few expansions with showrooms in different demographic areas within and outside Rajasthan.
capex_expansion.quote: We are planning for a few expansions, a few showrooms in different demographic areas like in Rajasthan and also outside the Rajasthan.

margins_costs.claim: Standalone EBITDA margin expanded by 176 basis points to 15.28% in FY24.
margins_costs.quote: Our EBITDA saw a significant rise of 28.53%, reaching INR63.75 crores, while the EBITDA margin expanded by 176 basis points to 15.28%.

orders_capacity.claim: The product portfolio boasts over 300,000 batches of jewellery, and currently features more than 3.5 lakh SKUs.
orders_capacity.quote: We have more than 3.5 lakh SAQs right now in our portfolio.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors determined that it would be prudent not to recommend any dividend on the equity shares of the Company for the financial year ended 31st March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors, after a comprehensive evaluation of all relevant factors and circumstances, has determined that it would be prudent not to recommend any dividend on the equity shares of the Company for the financial year ended 31st March 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The entire net profit of the Company amounting to Rs. 6,370.77 lakhs was transferred to Retained Earnings.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review, the entire net profit of the Company amounting to Rs. 6,370.77 lakhs was transferred to Retained Earnings.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors approved the transfer of Rs. 50 lakhs from Retained Earnings to the Capital Redemption Reserve.
capital_allocation.quote: In addition, the Board of Directors approved the transfer of Rs. 50 lakhs from Retained Earnings to the Capital Redemption Reserve.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors approved raising funds aggregating up to Rs. 350 crores by way of a Qualified Institutions Placement.
capital_allocation.quote: In order to support the Company's growth initiatives and strengthen its capital base, the Board of Directors, at its meeting held on March 6, 2026, approved the raising of funds aggregating up to Rs. 350 crores by way of a Qualified Institutions Placement (QIP), in accordance with the applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2013, the SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018, as amended, and other applicable laws, subject to the approval of the members and such other regulatory approvals as may be required.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors decided not to recommend any dividend on equity shares for the financial year ended March 31, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors of your company, after considering holistically the relevant circumstances have decided that it would be prudent, not to recommend any Dividend on equity shares of the Company for the financial year ended on 31st March 2025.

capital_allocation.claim: The company transferred the entire net profit amounting to Rs. 4,317.11 Lakhs to Retained earnings.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review the company has transferred the entire net profit amounting to Rs. 4,317.11 Lakhs to Retained earnings.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors transferred a sum of Rs. 50 lacs to the Capital Redemption Reserve from retained earnings.
capital_allocation.quote: Also, the Board of Directors of your company has transferred a sum of Rs. 50 lacs to the Capital Redemption Reserve from retained earnings.

capital_allocation.claim: The company approved the sub-division of equity shares such that 1 equity share having face value of 10 each was sub-divided into 10 equity shares having face value of 1 each.
capital_allocation.quote: During the period under review, the Board of Directors of your Company approved, the sub-division/ split of equity shares of your Company, such that 1 (one) equity share having face value of ₹10.00 (Rupees Ten only) each, fully paid-up, was sub-divided into 10 (ten) equity shares having face value of ₹1.00 (Rupee One only) each, fully paid-up.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated they will be investing in latest technologies in the near future.
management_commitments.quote: As of now we have not made huge investments in the technology and the new machineries, but we are planning to do that and for the time being, we are focusing on improving our inventories to cater customers with various products which fulfils their demand, but we will be investing in the latest technologies as well.

management_commitments.claim: The company refreshes its designs every 3 months by adding approximately 20% to 30% to its portfolio.
management_commitments.quote: We refresh our design every 3 months. We addition near about 20%-30% in our portfolio.

management_commitments.claim: Your directors expect improved performance in current year.
management_commitments.quote: Your directors expect improved performance in current year.
